research_scope.contribution: edge-informed connected-control-volume conservation applied only to a collaborator-supplied high-fidelity zone

data_contract.retry_invariant: Only the maximum internal solver step may decrease; forcing, geometry, five-minute output, split, and quality thresholds remain unchanged.
data_contract.node_precipitation_source: pre-simulation raster values and cell weights

target_contract.face_target: HEC-RAS Face Flow Period Average multiplied by the exact 300-second interval
target_contract.edge_target_projection: minimum-L2 correction of native internal face volumes to match HGN storage change minus known raster precipitation and omitted boundary-face divergence
target_contract.cell_only_control: period-average face divergence plus known raster precipitation collapsed to per-cell net budget; edge values are not exposed to the model
target_contract.direct_cell_balance_reason: Cell Flow Balance is a point output, whereas Face Flow Period Average is interval-resolved and matches the five-minute model transition.
target_contract.conservation_scope: 127 connected high-fidelity interior control volumes; external-boundary nodes excluded

required_methods.definition: HydroGraphNet architecture and original graph-level physics objective with only the documented SI/time/data adapters
Unmodified NVIDIA loader on a deterministic 20-minute compatibility view; compare proposed and no-edge methods on the same view and label separately from the native five-minute experiment
High-zone per-cell net budget supervision without learned edge output
Selective physical-face head with Face Flow supervision but no hard projection or conservative state feedback
Frozen trained HGN backbone plus selective edge head and exact connected-control-volume projection
Joint HGN node and selective edge-head training through differentiable exact connected-control-volume projection
The same HGN edge head evaluated on every internal face
DUALFloodGNN adapted to the same graph, variables, split, forcing, horizon, hardware, and timing protocol; never used as the proposed backbone

development_selection.test_use: one pass only after method, checkpoint, seeds, thresholds, code hashes, and statistics are frozen

publication_claim_boundary.allowed_if_all_gates_pass: HydroGraphNet-based selective physical-edge local conservation improves high-zone forecasting and raw local budget consistency with lower complete inference cost than an adapted full-edge DUALFloodGNN benchmark on the same Minxiong dataset.
not_allowed_without_additional_evidence: better than all existing flood GNNs
forecast improvement inferred only from exact projected closure
